trailhead.label: The Schenken car park by the Lantschnay bus stop, the board’s start

cautions: The board warns that some stretches can be very icy in winter.
Almost all on a quiet asphalt road with a few cars: keep your dog on a short lead.
About 180 m on the provincial road by the start: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.About 180 m on the provincial road by th: Circa 180 m sulla strada provinciale vicino alla partenza: tieni il cane vicino.
